## Functions

### `entasis_active_body_view`

acquires zero-copy active-body structure-of-arrays columns

sleeping bodies are intentionally excluded and remain accessible by handle. ownership: owner thread only while the world is idle

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_status_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_active_body_view(entasis_world_t * world, entasis_active_body_view_t * out_view, entasis_diagnostic_t * diagnostic);
```

| Parameter    | C type                         | Meaning                                                                      |
| ------------ | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `world`      | `entasis_world_t *`            | target world                                                                 |
| `out_view`   | `entasis_active_body_view_t *` | receives the borrowed active body view                                       |
| `diagnostic` | `entasis_diagnostic_t *`       | optional diagnostic output, or NULL when detailed failure data is not needed |

returns ENTASIS_STATUS_OK on success or a failure status

### `entasis_body_view_valid`

reports whether an active-body view still names current storage

this is a diagnostic check, not permission to retain a view across a documented invalidation boundary

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_bool_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_body_view_valid(entasis_world_t * world, const entasis_active_body_view_t * view);
```

| Parameter | C type                               | Meaning                  |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| `world`   | `entasis_world_t *`                  | target world             |
| `view`    | `const entasis_active_body_view_t *` | borrowed view to inspect |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE while the view still names current world storage

### `entasis_active_body_row`

selects one zero-copy active-body row

validate the view once before an iteration. this helper checks only the captured range

```c
ENTASIS_API entasis_bool_t ENTASIS_CALL entasis_active_body_row(const entasis_active_body_view_t * view, uint64_t index, entasis_active_body_row_t * out_row);
```

| Parameter | C type                               | Meaning                               |
| --------- | ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `view`    | `const entasis_active_body_view_t *` | borrowed view to inspect              |
| `index`   | `uint64_t`                           | zero-based row index                  |
| `out_row` | `entasis_active_body_row_t *`        | receives the selected active body row |

returns ENTASIS_TRUE when index selects a valid active body row
